newsitem.title: CROATIA: Indonesia interested in Croatia's pharmaceuticals.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia interested in Croatia's pharmaceuticals.

text.p: Indonesia is interested in buying pharmaceutical products from two major Croatian drugs companies, state television said on Monday.

An Indonesian delegation led by the health minister Sujudi visited Croatia's flagship pharmaceutical companies Pliva and Belupo and discussed the possibility of placing their products in Indonesia's growing market, state agency Hina reported.
Sujudi said the country's improved health care standards allowed wider use of drugs, especially antibiotics.
